class.name: AudioClock
class.brief_description: Synchronizes musical game logic to live audio playback time.
class.description: The AudioClock monitors an [AudioStreamPlayer] and translates playback time into musical position using data provided by a [SongData] resource. It tracks the current measure and beat, supports measure-based looping, and emits signals when beat, measure, marker, and loop events occur. When an audio player is connected, the clock follows the player's playback position rather than relying on frame delta time.

method.name: clear_loop
method.description: Disables looping and clears any active loop bounds.

method.name: get_current_measure
method.description: Returns the current measure number using 1-based numbering for public-facing use.

method.name: get_num_measures
method.description: Returns the total number of measures defined by the loaded [SongData].

method.name: get_song_time
method.description: Returns the current playback position in seconds. When synchronized to an [AudioStreamPlayer], this reflects the active audio playback position.

method.name: is_looping
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if a loop section is currently active.

method.name: is_running
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if the clock is currently advancing and emitting musical events.

method.name: resume
method.description: Resumes the clock without resetting the current playback position, measure, or beat state.

method.name: set_loop_bounds_measure
method.description: Sets the loop section using 1-based measure numbers. When playback reaches the end measure boundary, the clock emits [signal loop_occurred] with the loop restart time.

method.name: set_loop_bounds_time
method.description: Sets the loop section directly using time values in seconds.

method.name: start
method.description: Starts the clock from [param time_offset] seconds. This resets internal beat and measure tracking so playback can begin cleanly from a new position.

method.name: stop
method.description: Stops the clock. No beat, measure, marker, or loop signals will be emitted while stopped.

members.member: Path to the [AudioStreamPlayer] node this clock should monitor for live playback position.
The [SongData] resource containing the tempo map, measure offsets, beat counts, and cue markers for the current song.

signal.name: beat
signal.description: Emitted when the clock enters a new beat. Beat numbers are emitted using 1-based numbering.

signal.name: loop_occurred
signal.description: Emitted when playback reaches the loop end point and should return to [param new_time].

signal.name: marker_passed
signal.description: Emitted when playback enters a measure that contains a parsed cue or rehearsal marker.

signal.name: measure
signal.description: Emitted when the clock enters a new measure. Measure numbers are emitted using 1-based numbering.
